ev-start.intro.say: Evalation checks your code against the security and compliance standards you choose, and writes reports on what it finds.

ev-start.clock.say: This machine's clock is wrong. Set it to the right time, then run /ev-start again.

ev-start.other.say: Evalation couldn't check this machine just now. Run /ev-start again in a few minutes.

ev-start.unreachable.say: Evalation couldn't be reached. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-start again.

ev-start.signing-in.say: Signing in creates your Evalation account, or links this machine to the one you have.

ev-start.chosen.say: You're set up to check code against <titles>.

ev-start.packs-unread.say: Your packs couldn't be read just now. Run /ev-start again in a few minutes.

ev-start.no-packs.say: Run /ev-packs when you're ready to choose what to check against.

ev-start.run-here.say: Run /ev-run here to check this repository.

ev-start.run-elsewhere.say: Next, open Claude Code in the repository you want checked and run /ev-run.

ev-start.cost.say: It uses <count> pack credits, and you have <credits>.

ev-start.cost-one.say: It uses one pack credit, and you have <credits>.

ev-start.short.say: This selection uses <count> pack credits and you have <credits>. Run /ev-account to buy more, or /ev-packs to choose fewer packs.

ev-start.short-one.say: This selection uses one pack credit and you have none. Run /ev-account to buy some.

ev-start.credits-unread.say: Your pack credits couldn't be read just now. Run /ev-account in a minute to see them.
